tagline: Fiserv is a leading global provider of payments and financial services technology solutions serving merchants, financial institutions, and corporate clients worldwide.
hero_kpi_rationale: Fiserv is integrating AI into its products and operations to improve efficiency, scalability, and innovation. This approach is central to the One Fiserv strategy launched in Q3 2025 and represents a key driver for future growth.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of revenue generated by the company during a fiscal year.
kpis.description: Total revenue represents all sales of goods and services.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: A company's profit after deducting operating expenses.
kpis.description: Operating income measures the profitability of a company's core operations before interest and taxes.

kpis.short: Net Cash Provided by Operating Activities
kpis.name: Net Cash Provided by Operating Activities
kpis.explanation: Amount of cash generated by the company's core business operations.
kpis.description: Indicates the company's ability to generate cash from its primary activities.

kpis.name: Processing and Services Revenue Mix
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue derived from processing and other recurring service offerings.
kpis.description: Measures the share of revenue from transaction-based and multi-year service contracts with high renewal rates. In 2025, represents 80% of total revenue ($16,879M of $21,193M), highlighting the non-discretionary and stable nature of the services.
kpis.signal: Dominance of recurring and stable revenue streams.

kpis.name: AI_Integration
kpis.explanation: Systematic integration of artificial intelligence into products, services, and operations to enhance efficiency and innovation.
kpis.description: A key component of the One Fiserv action plan launched in Q3 2025. AI is used for process simplification, advanced automation, technical resilience, and operating model reengineering. The strategy aims to create a more productive and higher-quality company by modernizing the technology infrastructure and improving operational efficiency.
kpis.signal: Fiserv is leveraging AI to modernize technology infrastructure and optimize operations.

kpis.name: Acquisitions Value
kpis.explanation: Total cost of businesses acquired and investments completed by Fiserv during the fiscal year.
kpis.description: 8 acquisitions completed in 2025 (StoneCastle, TD Merchant Canada, SCG, CardFree, Money Money, Pinch Payments, CCV, Payfare) for a net amount of $856M (aggregate before deduction of $84M of acquired cash and including estimated earn-out provisions of $35M). This strategy supports organic expansion and geographic reach.
kpis.signal: Active acquisition strategy to broaden product offerings and geographic coverage.

risks.title: Goodwill and Intangible Assets Impairment
risks.score_rationale: The company holds a significant base of goodwill and intangible assets resulting from its strategic acquisitions. Annual impairment tests are performed, and a significant impairment could have a material impact on the consolidated financial statements, particularly following the 2025 acquisitions.

risks.title: Foreign Currency Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The company operates across multiple geographic regions (United States, Canada, EMEA, LATAM, APAC), representing 16% of revenue in 2025. Fluctuations in foreign exchange rates could affect consolidated financial results and period-over-period comparability.

risks.title: Regulation and Tax Compliance Complexity
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in multiple jurisdictions with complex and evolving tax and regulatory regimes. Changes in tax legislation, tax audits, or divergent regulatory interpretations could result in significant tax liability adjustments or penalties.

ai_positioning.summary: Fiserv takes an active and strategic position on AI. The One Fiserv action plan launched in Q3 2025 explicitly integrates AI as a key strategic pillar, with a commitment to embed AI across products, services, and operations to improve efficiency, scalability, and innovation. The company uses AI for process simplification, advanced automation, technology infrastructure modernization, and operating model reengineering.
evidence: One Fiserv action plan (Q3 2025): embedding AI to create a higher-quality, more productive business
Long-term focus: realizing productivity and efficiency gains by embedding artificial intelligence in products, services and business operations
Delivering operational excellence enabled by AI as a strategic pillar
Modernizing technology infrastructure, enhancing resiliency, and reengineering operating model through AI and advanced automation
